quest.title: Evermotion Mechanical Painting
quest.description: Félix Yogue, a person from the Court of Fontaine, seems to be having some problems...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: The passion of Mondstadt is well-founded, I say. More so than I imagined, in fact... even their hilichurls are so very lively.

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Regardless, Mr. Yogue, we ask that you not go out by yourself again.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: What? Then what about my machine? I'm still missing... um...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: We've got adventurers working on finding them. Just wait here in the city where it's safe, please...

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: But without that device, my... It's a matter of inspiration, you understand? What shall I do when inspiration strikes?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Ah, it comes and it goes... Like a belch after a good drink, or a candle in the wind!

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Hmm, actually, that's not a bad analogy. I should write it down. I'm sure Xavier would love it...

dialogues.speaker: Swan
dialogues.text: Huh? Honorary Knight? Ah, wonderful! Just the person I wanted to see! Please, over here!

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: Well, allow me to introduce you. This man here is from the Court of Fontaine...

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: No man am I, but a daydreamer! That is how we name ourselves!

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: ...So, Mr. Yogue, this is our Honorary Knight...

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Yogue! Félix Yogue. Salutations to you, Honorary Knight! Long have I heard of your many exploits.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know of me?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Of course, of course! Who wouldn't?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Your battle against Dvalin in Mondstadt made headlines in The Steambird for three whole weeks!

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Hahaha, if those reporters knew that I was speaking to you right now, why, they would be beside themselves with envy!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What's The Steambird?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Ah, you don't know? It's a... Ah, let's say it's a rather popular newspaper in the Court of Fontaine.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: You once got their sales up to record numbers, I'll have you know.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Headlines, you say?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Indeed! And you got their sales up to record numbers, to boot!

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Front-page, full-length, expert interviews up the wazoo, and the best hand-drawn illustrations Mora could buy! You made a lot of people mad Mora there.

response.speaker: Swan
response.text: Well then... Traveler, Mr. Yogue, I shall leave you guys alone... I've got some other things to handle at the moment, if you'll excuse me.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Swan leaves in a hurry...

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Ah, it is as I was told. The Knights of Favonius have a never-ending backlog of work.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, why are you here in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Me? Well, I'm actually planning to tour Teyvat.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: As for the purpose of my trip, why, it is to promote these Kinesis Cores that I have made.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Simply put, a Kinesis Core is a form of clockwork device. As long as its mainspring is wound from time to time, these cores can provide motive force for a long period of time.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: I even created a sort of perpetual-motion toy powered by the Kinesis Core to show off its capabilities. I call it the Evermotion Mechanical Painting.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Unfortunately, while I'd love to show the device to you...

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Its allure was all too much for even monsters to resist.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: At the moment, they must have divvied my device up into many pieces in a manner most unfriendly, playing around with each component...

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: I have, of course, asked for the help of the Adventurers' Guild, but I have received no news from any adventurer so far...

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Honorary Knight, could you help me out as well, if you have a mind to?

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Believe me, neither my device nor the payment due will disappoint you!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Wonderful. You are indeed a mighty adventurer, and a mighty sympathetic one, too. Just as the papers said!

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: Ah, it's a shame that we're in Mondstadt. Were we in the Court of Fontaine, I would bring a few reporters from The Steambird for an exclusive interview with you.

response.speaker: Félix Yogue
response.text: I'm sure that your charisma would bowl them over to the point where you'd be guaranteed another three weeks' worth of headlines — not to mention the requisite royalties.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: You've returned, Honorary Knight. What news of the components?

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Yes, indeed! Ah, this is wonderful! Heavens, yes!

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Well now, since all the components have been returned to us, all that's left is to combine them...

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: Well then... Honorary Knight, if you want, you can attempt to put all the pieces together.

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: It will be an interesting experience, trust me!

dialogues.speaker: Félix Yogue
dialogues.text: #Well, {F#Ms.}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, I leave the matter of these components to you.
